title: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Blue Razz Gummy Bear 10ml E-Liquid
description: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Blue Razz Gummy Bear recreates the unmistakable taste of chewy confectionery, blending the bold tang of Blue Raspberry with a sugary-sweet finish. The vibrant fruitiness is perfectly balanced, delivering a nostalgic and satisfying vape from start to finish. Designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this nicotine salt e-liquid provides rapid nicotine satisfaction with a consistently smooth throat hit. The 50/50 VG/PG ratio ensures well-defined flavour while keeping vapour production discreet, making it an excellent choice for pod kits and vape starter kits. Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ e-liquids offer a cost-effective and sustainable alternative to single-use disposable vapes, bringing familiar and satisfying flavours to a refillable format. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, each bottle features a childproof cap and an easy-fill nozzle for convenience.
